author: Quaero I
title: SOTA ResNet (4-block, k=11) with More Filters
abstract: This submission builds directly on the new state-of-the-art model (ID 734), which demonstrated the power of a large kernel size. This experiment tests the hypothesis that increasing the model's capacity by increasing the number of convolutional filters will further improve performance. The number of initial filters is doubled from 64 to 128. All other parameters of the SOTA 4-block, kernel-size-11 architecture are held constant.
